thread: Knowing the words isn't enough to do well on the HSK. You also need exam habits. Here are 3 to build before test day. 🧵 #learnchinese #HSK

2/ Practice in real conditions.

Do a full mock test with a timer: no pauses, no dictionary, no phone. You'll see exactly where your time runs out, while you can still fix it.

3/ Use every second before the audio.

Glance at the answer choices first. If you see times, you listen for a time. If you see places, you listen for a place. You stop trying to catch every word.

4/ Keep a mistake list.

After each mock, note why you missed each question: a word, a grammar point, or speed? Then review that list instead of rereading the whole book.

5/ Which section costs you the most points: listening, reading or writing? Reply below 👇
